workstreams.name: Canonical contracts and governance
workstreams.mission: Preserve certified contracts and define stable extension, authority, query and promotion seams for future domains.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: World meaning remains stable and explainable while new capability can be added without rewriting certified history.
canonicalOutputs: future versioned contract decisions only after explicit promotion
crossScaleInvariants: certified history is not silently expanded
canonical/derived/presentation authority stays explicit
unknown and unsupported fail closed
workstreams.scientificStatus: Governance/formal architecture; no new scientific claim.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Planning and contract work must not add unbounded runtime state; runtime contracts declare budgets before promotion.
workstreams.promotionGate: Explicit versioned contract/ADR review with no silent change to frozen canonical bytes.
knownUnsupportedAreas: No generic future domain is canonical merely by appearing in the DAG.
promotionPrerequisites: single owner for each shared semantic surface

workstreams.name: Runtime, scheduling and portability
workstreams.mission: Provide bounded materialization, capability adaptation, workers, resource ownership and deterministic build composition for all scales.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Deep exploration remains responsive across hardware while Strict and Enhanced profiles preserve the same canonical universe.
crossScaleInvariants: quality changes never alter canonical truth
working set remains bounded independently of address-space size
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Explicit CPU, main-thread, heap, GPU, queue, startup and artifact-decode budgets per quality profile.
workstreams.promotionGate: Bounded-resource and portability evidence with canonical non-interference.
knownUnsupportedAreas: WebGPU is optional Enhanced capability, not a baseline requirement.

workstreams.name: Persistence, lineage and migrations
workstreams.mission: Extend P4's certified temporal/persistence model to future domain reducers without changing its frozen v1 meaning.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: The player can return to the same causal world and carry governed changes across sessions and versions.
crossScaleInvariants: full replay equals checkpoint plus bounded tail
domain reducers do not own time/order
history never depends on UI arrival order
workstreams.scientificStatus: Formal temporal/persistence semantics; domain science remains external.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Bounded live tail with deterministic compaction; long-lifetime growth handled by explicit archive/checkpoint policy.
workstreams.promotionGate: Every new mutable domain must bind a versioned transition contract and pass replay/checkpoint/compaction equivalence.
knownUnsupportedAreas: Retroactive history branching/revision is not P4 v1 ordinary commit semantics.

workstreams.name: Universal exploration and spatial query
workstreams.mission: Replace curated-destination assumptions with sparse address/query-driven discovery, selection and reversible scale/regime travel.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Players choose what they can see or query and travel through supported cosmic, planetary and local space without losing identity continuity.
crossScaleInvariants: selected canonical entity remains stable across presentation transitions
location/query context does not silently redefine identity
unsupported targets fail explicitly
workstreams.scientificStatus: Navigation/product architecture; scientific fields remain owned by domain providers.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Discovery must be non-enumerative and bounded; travel materializes only relevant neighborhoods/representations.
workstreams.promotionGate: Arbitrary supported target queries and continuous/reversible travel work without duplicate owners or canonical mutation.
knownUnsupportedAreas: Current v0.8/v0.9 fixed anchors and release bands are not final freedom semantics.

workstreams.name: Astronomy and cosmic-structure depth
workstreams.mission: Advance sparse cosmic/galactic/stellar generation beyond P3 v1 while preserving deterministic random access and honest scientific status.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Many causally differentiated galaxies, neighborhoods, systems and stars can be discovered and explored rather than one showcase structure.
crossScaleInvariants: planet/system/star identity and forcing are not rerolled downstream
sparse lookup remains bounded
workstreams.scientificStatus: P3 v1 certified in scope; richer astronomy is PLANNED/RESEARCH until versioned promotion.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Non-enumerative random access with declared dependency depth and bounded discovery neighborhoods.
workstreams.promotionGate: Versioned successor with explicit fidelity/provenance and cross-runtime deterministic evidence.
knownUnsupportedAreas: P3 v1 is not a complete cosmology/stellar-evolution simulator.

workstreams.name: Planetary physics, geology, hydrology and climate
workstreams.mission: Develop scientifically governed planetary successors spanning interior, surface, atmosphere and climate without promoting presentation noise into truth.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Worlds gain explainable geography, environments and evolution that constrain what the player sees and what life can support.
canonicalOutputs: future physical geography/environment/climate states after promotion
crossScaleInvariants: regional/local geography refines planetary constraints
mass/energy/volatile conservation where declared
surface presentation cannot claim physical elevation without authority
workstreams.scientificStatus: P5 v1 and Environment v2 certified in narrow scope; greenhouse surface climate, XUV/escape, real geology/hydrology/oceans remain unsupported or research.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Sparse global-to-local queries; no required whole-planet high-resolution materialization; regional processes use bounded active domains.
workstreams.promotionGate: New versioned authority establishes each claimed field and passes scientific, deterministic and cross-scale evidence without altering frozen P5 contracts.
promotionPrerequisites: F-STATE mutable transition binding where needed

workstreams.name: Deep history and late materialization
workstreams.mission: Generate deep macro/meso/micro history under P4 authority while materializing local detail only when constrained and relevant.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Ruins, migrations, ecological change and local stories can be traced to prior causal history rather than appearing as props.
crossScaleInvariants: fine history cannot contradict committed coarse facts
significant local effects PROJECT upward
dematerialization preserves canonical commitments
workstreams.scientificStatus: Formal simulation architecture; domain historical models require their own evidence/fidelity labels.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: COLD/WARM/HOT/IMMEDIATE bounded active state; no requirement to retain every individual through cosmic time.
workstreams.promotionGate: Late detail is reproducibly constrained by prior state and projects significant consequences without unbounded history materialization.
knownUnsupportedAreas: No universal individual-level history is currently implemented.

workstreams.name: Life, ecology and evolution
workstreams.mission: Advance from P6 v1 fail-closed eligibility to scientifically honest positive biology, ecology and bounded evolution only when upstream authority supports it.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Some worlds can genuinely support generated/evolved life whose ecology and history are constrained by their environments.
canonicalOutputs: future biosphere/ecology/lineage states after explicit promotion
crossScaleInvariants: environment constrains biology
population/energy totals reconcile across semantic LOD
ephemeral individuals do not silently become persistent identity
workstreams.scientificStatus: P6 v1 frozen fail-closed; Biology-v2 research is non-canonical; abiogenesis remains unsupported/research.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Bounded active populations and late materialization; no simultaneous individual simulation of a biosphere.
workstreams.promotionGate: A separately versioned positive path must establish environment authority, biology identity/lifecycle and P4 replay without relying on test/research fixtures.

workstreams.name: Civilization, culture, economy and institutions
workstreams.mission: Model societies as consequences of environment, resources, biology, population, interaction and history rather than decorative flags.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Players can encounter settlements, cultures, technologies, economies, conflicts and ruins with traceable causal histories.
crossScaleInvariants: city existence derives from population/resources/history
local settlements reconcile with regional population/economy
ruins require prior causal state
workstreams.scientificStatus: PLANNED/RESEARCH; social models must declare stylization, assumptions and non-predictive limits.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Aggregate populations/economies at COLD/WARM; groups/agents materialize only in HOT/IMMEDIATE contexts under hard caps.
workstreams.promotionGate: Versioned causal model demonstrates environment/resource/population/history dependence and bounded replayable state.
knownUnsupportedAreas: No canonical settlements, languages, economies or civilizations exist today.

workstreams.name: Gameplay, intervention and consequences
workstreams.mission: Turn exploration into meaningful governed actions whose effects enter canonical history through versioned domain transitions.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Players can change supported worlds and later observe persistent causal consequences.
canonicalOutputs: accepted canonical events through authorized reducers
crossScaleInvariants: UI never directly rewrites truth
actions target stable canonical entities/addresses
significant local effects project to appropriate scales
workstreams.scientificStatus: Gameplay mechanics inherit scientific status from domain reducers and must not bypass unsupported fields.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Interaction evaluation must be bounded and may use previews/caches; canonical commit remains deterministic.
workstreams.promotionGate: At least one meaningful supported action loop persists through P4 replay without UI-authoritative mutation.
knownUnsupportedAreas: Terraforming, biological seeding and civilization actions are future domain-dependent targets, not current features.

workstreams.name: Rendering and visual quality
workstreams.mission: Deliver maximum scientifically honest visual quality under bounded browser resources through portable and Enhanced backends.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: The universe looks coherent and compelling from cosmic to local and future microscopic scales without visual features masquerading as scientific facts.
crossScaleInvariants: visual transitions preserve entity/location context
LOD fixes do not become canonical geography
backend choice does not alter canonical truth
workstreams.scientificStatus: Presentation-only unless an upstream domain explicitly authorizes a visual field.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Adaptive LOD, dynamic resolution, bounded CPU/GPU caches and explicit destruction; quality scales before truth changes.
workstreams.promotionGate: No material visual defect on primary journeys, bounded resources, Strict fallback, and scientifically honest labels.
knownUnsupportedAreas: Current presentation terrain is not physical geology/topography
WebGPU Enhanced backend is not mature/certified

workstreams.name: Product experience, input and accessibility
workstreams.mission: Make the universe viewport the primary interface while providing contextual science, expert evidence and equivalent accessible controls.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: A non-expert can explore directly and understand the world; an expert can reach byte-level evidence without the app feeling like a dashboard.
crossScaleInvariants: user context follows canonical selection
unsupported/unknown remain distinguishable
equivalent controls do not change semantic actions
workstreams.scientificStatus: Presentation of scientific authority; cannot upgrade evidence status.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: UI work must respect frame/main-thread budgets and remain usable on mobile quality profiles.
workstreams.promotionGate: Viewport-first journey is direct, understandable, accessible and free of material product regressions.
knownUnsupportedAreas: Current panel/stage controls are transitional and not the final direct-manipulation contract.

workstreams.name: Microscopic biology
workstreams.mission: Reserve and research bounded organism-to-tissue-to-cell materialization with explicit multiscale adapters.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Future players can inspect progressively smaller living structures that remain connected to the same organism and environment.
canonicalOutputs: none until a separately promoted microscopic contract exists
crossScaleInvariants: microscopic detail remains constrained by organism/anatomy state
aggregate populations reconcile with fine materialization
ephemeral instances are not silently persistent identities
workstreams.scientificStatus: RESEARCH/ARCHITECTURALLY_RESERVED; no current cell simulation claim.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Local/query-driven bounded populations only; never all cells of all organisms simultaneously.
workstreams.promotionGate: No gate defined until F-LIFE provides authoritative organism/anatomy semantics and a bounded microscopic model is independently justified.

workstreams.name: Molecular and atomic representations
workstreams.mission: Research bounded local molecular/atomic representations and visualization without equating structural display with authoritative dynamics.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Future microscopic exploration can descend into molecular/atomic regimes where explicit models support it.
crossScaleInvariants: molecular detail reconciles with cell/material constraints
visualization does not imply dynamics
workstreams.scientificStatus: RESEARCH/ARCHITECTURALLY_RESERVED; no current molecular dynamics or atomic simulation claim.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Strictly local/query-driven materialization with declared particle/structure caps.
workstreams.promotionGate: Future explicit model contract with defensible validity and bounded browser execution.

workstreams.name: Non-classical and quantum-compatible research
workstreams.mission: Preserve architectural room for future non-classical model regimes with explicit observables and reconciliation rather than classical nested geometry assumptions.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: The architecture can evolve toward deeper physical representations without corrupting classical entity identity or making false quantum-simulation claims.
crossScaleInvariants: classical facts and non-classical observables require explicit compatibility
no assumption of literal spatial containment
workstreams.scientificStatus: SPECULATIVE/RESEARCH; explicitly not a brute-force quantum universe claim.
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: No runtime envelope accepted; any future model must be locally bounded and explicitly costed.
workstreams.promotionGate: No canonical promotion gate is currently defined.

workstreams.name: Systemic audio
workstreams.mission: Develop context-driven procedural/systemic audio as presentation that complements rather than replaces semantic accessibility.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: Scale, environment and events can have rich responsive sound while essential meaning remains available non-audibly.
crossScaleInvariants: audio meaning follows selected world context
audio cannot define canonical events
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Bounded voices/nodes/buffers and no critical frame-thread starvation.
workstreams.promotionGate: Systemic audio enriches experience without changing truth, blocking accessibility or violating runtime budgets.
knownUnsupportedAreas: No mature systemic audio layer exists today.

workstreams.name: Conformance, device lab and release certification
workstreams.mission: Map every public claim to exact-source deterministic, scientific, visual, UX, performance and device evidence.
workstreams.userVisibleOutcome: A released universe is not only test-green but demonstrably scientifically honest, usable, visually sound, portable and reproducible.
crossScaleInvariants: certification cannot upgrade unsupported science
green semantic CI cannot override material visual/UX defects
exact-source identity is preserved
workstreams.performanceEnvelope: Certification itself may be expensive; release runtime budgets are workstream-defined and independently measured.
workstreams.promotionGate: Every release claim has matching exact-candidate evidence and no unresolved material blocker across co-equal product dimensions.
knownUnsupportedAreas: Wave IV is technically certified; the expanded v1.0 models and product remain subject to actual implementation and release evidence.
promotionPrerequisites: selected release workstreams meet their own gates
physical-device evidence stays explicit; current v1.0 mandate permits engineering and release without another physical ceremony
